author: Omar Yazeedi
description: Two-way sync with your self-hosted Graphite (Life Planner) server: pull Spaces into any vault as Markdown, edit in Obsidian, push back through a validate-first merge. Sync panel with per-file status, destination-vault routing, optional auto-push. - This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.

releases.author: OmarYazeedi
releases.description: Hide sync ids (on by default): the lp: id markers the merge importer uses are now invisible in tracked files - hidden in live preview/source (revealed on the line you are editing) and stripped from reading view. The file itself is untouched; pushes still carry every id. Toggle in settings.

releases.author: OmarYazeedi
releases.description:
Initial public release.

- Pull any Space as server-canonical Markdown into a chosen vault
- Validate-first push (errors with line numbers; nothing half-lands)
- Sync panel with per-file state and actions
- Selective module sync, optional auto-push
- Reports its vault to the server for the mirror-folder dropdown
